matches.title: York City LFC vs Crawley Town
matches.description: Watch York City LFC vs Crawley Town highlights and goals from Carabao on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on August 3, 2026. York City LFC and Crawley Town faced off in a highly anticipated Carabao Cup fixture on August 3, 2026, as both teams aimed to secure their place in the next round. The match provided a platform for tactical battles and individual brilliance in a contest that kept fans on the edge of their seats. Early Breakthrough for the Visitors The match began with a fast-paced tempo, as both sides looked to establish dominance in the midfield. However, it was Crawley Town who found the early rhythm. In the 24th minute, a slick passing move saw Kellan Gordon provide a perfectly weighted assist for Gianmarco Di Biase , who clinical finish gave the visitors the lead. This goal forced York City LFC to push higher up the pitch, creating an open and exciting first half. As the game progressed, the physicality intensified. Several players found themselves in the referee's book, with Ben Brookes and Jude Arthurs receiving yellow cards before the break. Despite the pressure from the home side, Crawley Town managed to maintain their narrow advantage heading into the interval. Tactical Shifts and the Final Blow The second half saw a series of tactical changes as both managers looked to influence the outcome. Danilo Orsi was introduced for the goalscorer Di Biase in the 54th minute, a move that would prove decisive. The contest remained feisty, with the referee busy issuing cautions to Charlie Barker , Johnny Russell , and Zech Medley as the battle for control continued. In the 86th minute, the defining moment arrived when Crawley Town were awarded a penalty. Danilo Orsi stepped up and calmly slotted the ball home from the spot, doubling his side's lead and effectively ending any hopes of a comeback for York City LFC . Despite five minutes of added time, the visitors remained resolute to secure their victory and progression in the tournament.
